schemes.title: AICTE Post Graduate (PG) Scholarship for GATE / GPAT / CEED Qualified Students
schemes.department: All India Council for Technical Education
schemes.description: Financial assistance of ₹12,400 per month (total ₹1,48,800/year) to full-time GATE, GPAT or CEED qualified students admitted to AICTE-approved postgraduate engineering and architecture programs.

schemes.title: UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) in Sciences and Humanities
schemes.description: Premier national doctoral research fellowship granting ₹37,000 per month (plus HRA) for UGC-NET and CSIR-UGC NET qualified scholars undertaking Ph.D. research in Indian universities.
